faq_one_question: Why don't I have free space on my phone after the cleaning process?
faq_one_question_android: Why don't I have free space on my phone after the cleaning process?
faq_one_answer: After Cleaner AI's cleaning process, deleted photos/videos are moved to the "Recently Deleted" album in your Photos app for 30 days. To free up space, open Photos, go to Recently Deleted, select items, and tap "Delete."
faq_one_answer_android: After Cleanup's cleaning process, deleted photos/videos are moved to the Trash folder in your Gallery for 30 days. To free up space, open the Gallery, go to Trash folder, select items, and tap "Delete."
faq_two_question: How do I recover deleted photos/videos?
faq_two_question_android: How do I recover deleted photos/videos?
faq_two_answer: Deleted items are stored in Recently Deleted for 30 days. Open Photos, select Recently Deleted, choose items, and tap "Recover." Or tap "Select" then "Recover All." This includes both manually deleted and Cleaner AI removed photos.
faq_two_answer_android: Deleted items are stored in Trash folder for 30 days. Open the Gallery, select Trash, choose items, and tap "Recover." Or tap "Select" then "Recover All." This includes both manually deleted and Cleanup removed photos.
faq_three_question: Does Cleaner AI guarantee my photos won't be uploaded?
faq_three_question_android: Does Cleanup guarantee my photos won't be uploaded?
faq_three_answer: Cleaner AI works offline, analyzing photos locally. It doesn't upload or send reports about your photos, only anonymous technical logs.
faq_three_answer_android: Cleanup works offline, analyzing photos locally. It doesn't upload or send reports about your photos, only anonymous technical logs.
faq_four_question: How does Cleaner AI choose the best photos?
faq_four_question_android: How does Cleanup choose the best photos?

faq_four_answer_android: Cleanup uses detection and comparison techniques, including face recognition and edits. It marks a photo as the "Best Result" based on its algorithm but always review suggestions.

contact_us_one_question: How do I recover deleted photos or videos?
contact_us_one_question_android: How do I recover deleted photos or videos?
contact_us_one_answer:
In case you unintentionally deleted a photo or video, there's no need to worry. Cleaner AI's cleaning process is in line with the cleaning process of the iOS Photos app: all deleted photos/videos will be moved to the Recently Deleted album in your library for 30 days. So, you will still be able to recover deleted photos or videos for 30 days if you make a mistake. The iOS Photos app automatically erases photos from your iPhone after 30 days.

To recover a photo or video that was deleted less than 30 days ago, follow these steps:

  • Open the Photos app on your phone and tap on the Recently Deleted album.
  • Tap on Select in the upper-right corner.
  • Choose the files you want to recover, then tap Recover.

If you need to recover everything in the Recently Deleted album, you can do so by tapping Select and then Recover All.

Keep in mind that this album includes both manually deleted photos and the ones that are removed by Cleaner AI.
contact_us_one_answer_android:
In case you unintentionally deleted a photo or video, there's no need to worry. Cleanup's cleaning process is in line with the cleaning process of the Gallery app: all deleted photos/videos will be moved to the Trash folder in your gallery for 30 days. So, you will still be able to recover deleted photos or videos for 30 days if you make a mistake. The Gallery app automatically erases photos from your phone after 30 days.

To recover a photo or video that was deleted less than 30 days ago, follow these steps:

  • Open the Gallery app on your phone and tap on the Trash folder.
  • Tap on Select in the upper-right corner.
  • Choose the files you want to recover, then tap Restore.

If you need to recover everything in the Trash folder, you can do so by tapping Select and then Restore All.

Keep in mind that this album includes both manually deleted photos and the ones that are removed by Cleanup.
contact_us_two_question: Why don't I have free space on my phone after the cleaning process?
contact_us_two_question_android: Why don't I have free space on my phone after the cleaning process?
contact_us_two_answer:
Cleaner AI's cleaning process is in line with the cleaning process of the iOS Photos app: all deleted photos/videos will be moved to the Recently Deleted album in your library for 30 days. The iOS Photos app automatically erases photos from your iPhone after 30 days.

To free up storage, follow these steps:

  • Open the Photos app on your iPhone, scroll down, and tap on the Recently Deleted album.
  • Tap on Delete All.

Keep in mind that this album includes both manually deleted photos and the ones that are removed by Cleaner AI.
contact_us_two_answer_android:
Cleanup's cleaning process is in line with the cleaning process of the Gallery app: all deleted photos/videos will be moved to the Trash folder album in your library for 30 days. The Gallery app automatically erases photos from your phone after 30 days.

To free up storage, follow these steps:

  • Open the Gallery app on your phone and tap on the Trash folder.
  • Tap on Delete All.

Keep in mind that this album includes both manually deleted photos and the ones that are removed by Cleanup.
contact_us_three_question: How can I cancel my subscription?
contact_us_three_question_android: How can I cancel my subscription?
contact_us_three_answer:
We're sorry to hear that you didn't have the best experience with Cleaner AI. Unfortunately, Cleaner AI does not have the authority to make changes to your subscription plan. Apple manages payment processes to protect user privacy.

You can follow these steps to cancel your subscription:

https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039

Thank you for your understanding.
contact_us_three_answer_android:
We're sorry to hear that you didn't have the best experience with Cleanup. Unfortunately, Cleanup does not have the authority to make changes to your subscription plan. Google Play manages payment processes to protect user privacy.

You can follow these steps to cancel your subscription:

https://support.google.com/googleplay/answer/7018481

Thank you for your understanding.
contact_us_four_question: Why can’t I allow Cleaner AI to access my photos?
contact_us_four_answer:
If you cannot see the Allow Photo Access option in the settings, you can follow these steps:

  1. Launch the Settings app.

  2. Swipe down and tap Screen Time.

  3. Select Content & Privacy Restrictions.

  4. Locate and tap Photos.

  5. Be sure to check the Allow Changes option.

  6. Make sure you give full access to Cleaner AI.

  7. Then terminate Cleaner AI and reopen.
